title: LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications
summary: 本文综述了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的预测与预报智能体，这类系统将语言推理与时间序列数据、证据检索、外部工具及迭代预测相结合，用于对未来或当前未观测目标进行评分预测。文章将现有架构分为三类：独立LLM工作流（直接处理编码的时间序列）、增强型LLM系统（集成检索和工具）、以及多智能体协作框架。内容涵盖训练方法（如监督微调、强化学习）、评估基准（如时间序列预测、事件预测）以及实际应用（如金融、医疗、气象）。该研究为预测领域提供了新范式，利用LLM的常识推理和外部知识提升预测准确性，值得关注。

key_insights: LLM-based forecasting agents combine language reasoning with temporal data and tools, enabling more flexible and context-aware predictions.
Architectures are categorized into standalone LLM workflows, augmented systems, and multi-agent frameworks, each with distinct trade-offs.
Training and evaluation methods are critical, with benchmarks needed to assess accuracy and robustness across domains.
Applications span finance, healthcare, and weather, showing broad potential but requiring careful handling of uncertainty.
